title: Rental Desk Guidance: Last Covered Day of a Rideshare Authorization under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the last covered rideshare day of a rideshare authorization depends on how the rideshare ended. The answer is read from the claim's rental ledger.

**Rule.**
- When a rental car authorization on the claim was entered on the end date of the rideshare authorization's closing, the last covered rideshare day is the day before that rental car's start date.
- When the rideshare authorization has no closing on the ledger, the last covered rideshare day is the last of its authorized days. The authorized days are the authorization plus every extension of it, counted from its start date.
- In any other case, the last covered rideshare day is the end date of its closing.

The covered rideshare days run through the last covered rideshare day, that day included.

## Decision table

| Closing on the ledger | Rental car authorization entered on the closing's end date | Last covered rideshare day |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The day before that rental car's start date |
| Yes | No | The end date of the closing |
| No | — | The last of the authorized days |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, rideshare authorization starting June 1)

1. The rideshare authorization closed with an end date of June 6. A rental car authorization was entered on June 6 with a start date of June 5. The last covered rideshare day is June 4.
2. The rideshare authorization closed with an end date of June 6, and no rental car authorization was entered that day. The last covered rideshare day is June 6.
3. The rideshare authorization has 7 authorized days and no closing yet. The last covered rideshare day is June 7.
